caption: Governed delegation joins an assignment to relevant knowledge, durable work, and acceptance evidence. Context selection is bounded and advisory. Dispatch gates act on assignment structure and resolved phase state; completion review evaluates landed work and independent evidence. Recovery preserves existing artifacts before work is reassigned.
conversion: Shared SVG/native blueprint geometry; documented historical authority boundaries
svg_title: Governed delegation with bounded guidance and separate admission
svg_description: A work order supplies target scope and declared phase identity. Engineering models and target scope feed bounded context selection, which guides an agent but does not enforce every obligation. Selected dispatch checks evaluate the brief and resolved phase state; absence of completion evidence is not a positive DONE match. The implementing agent preserves durable artifacts. Completion review evaluates landed work and independent evidence before recording acceptance. Interrupted or unresolved work is inspected before reassignment.
